description.ja: ”次世代のファーストガンプラ”。“40年の技術が可能にした簡単組立×ハイクオリティの共存！”
description.en: “Next generation first Gunpla”. “Easy assembly and high quality coexist, made possible by 40 technologies!”

description.ja: ENTRY GRADEシリーズに『RX-78-2 ガンダム』が登場!!
description.en: “RX-78-2 Gundam” is now available in the ENTRY GRADE series!!

description.ja: 初めてガンプラに触れる人、久しぶりにガンプラを組む人、ガンプラをこよなく愛する人、全ユーザーにお届けする新感覚の組み立てが体験できるプラモデルキットです。
description.en: ModelKit is a plastic model that allows all users to experience a new type of assembly, including those who are touching Gunpla for the first time, those who are assembling Gunpla for the first time in a while, and those who love Gunpla.

description.ja: 簡単に組み立てが可能ながら精巧なガンプラを完成できる、新感覚をぜひその手に。
description.en: Get your hands on a new sensation of easily assembling and completing elaborate Gunpla.

description.ja: • 積み重ねた技術により少数パーツでありながら抜群の可動！
description.en: • Thanks to accumulated technology, it is extremely movable despite having a small number of parts!

description.ja: • パーツを組み立てるだけで完成！塗装はもちろん、シール貼りも不要！
description.en: • Complete by simply assembling the parts! No painting or sealing required!

description.ja: • ニッパーを使わず手でパチパチと簡単に折れるタッチゲート仕様！
description.en: • Touch gate design that allows you to easily fold by hand without using nippers!

description.ja: • 部位ごとにまとまったランナー配置！
description.en: • Runner arrangement organized by body part!
